subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should provider-level auth status allow a healthy OAuth profile to mask missing OAuth/profile states, or should the override apply only to stale expired inventory?
rationale: That choice defines the operator-visible auth-provider status contract and can change upgrade behavior for existing mixed-profile setups.

options.title: Keep Missing Visible
options.body: Apply the healthy-OAuth override only to stale expired inventory, keep missing profiles red, and add focused coverage before merge.

options.title: Accept Healthy Masks Missing
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally let healthy OAuth suppress missing inventory, but should record that contract and add tests proving the intended behavior.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the stale badge requires this rollup change, the cache-refresh PR, or both.

recommendation.title: Keep Missing Visible
recommendation.body: Apply the healthy-OAuth override only to stale expired inventory, keep missing profiles red, and add focused coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth-health and provider-status history makes this the best available routing owner for the status-contract choice.
